_comment: Maintained in the TraitorDash repository (pelican/). Import it in the panel under Admin > Eggs.
name: TraitorDash
author: traitordash.opt237@passmail.net
description: TraitorDash: web dashboard for configuring a GMod TTT2 server (Bun + Hono + SQLite). The app files are deployed into the server's volume; this egg only runs them.

startup_commands.Default: if [ -f /home/container/package.json ]; then bun install --production --frozen-lockfile; fi; bun run {{MAIN_FILE}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# TraitorDash installation
#
# The app itself is deployed into /mnt/server (the server's files) by whatever deploys it (for
# example the backend.tar.gz from the releases), and its dependencies are installed by the startup
# command (bun install). This only makes sure the directory exists, and, when exact map geometry is
# switched on (MAP_GEOMETRY=1, RFC 11), fetches the download helper it needs.
DIR="${SERVER_DIR:-/mnt/server}"
mkdir -p "$DIR"

if [ "${MAP_GEOMETRY}" != "1" ]; then
    echo "TraitorDash: nothing to install; deploy the app files, then start the server."
    exit 0
fi

# DepotDownloader (GPL-2.0, https://github.com/SteamRE/DepotDownloader) is downloaded from its
# upstream release, not shipped with TraitorDash, and run only as a separate program. The version
# and the checksums are pinned: a different file is refused.
VERSION="3.4.0"
case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64)          ARCH="x64";   SUM="a999dec66b4850fc961bd50366696d23c2d0fad7b18790e6a5647b2f19097a53" ;;
    aarch64|arm64)   ARCH="arm64"; SUM="d9fb612ccebc1db8eeea3b4045d2221ec70431381393ce908fb72f01d4f9c812" ;;
    armv7l|armv8l)   ARCH="arm";   SUM="6cd66cd4f4f1e99ca2b30ca5ce097545d93bdad1fa754d9a74d8738e9e4e1022" ;;
    *) echo "TraitorDash: no DepotDownloader build for $(uname -m); exact map geometry will not work."; exit 0 ;;
esac

TMP="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
URL="https://github.com/SteamRE/DepotDownloader/releases/download/DepotDownloader_${VERSION}/DepotDownloader-linux-${ARCH}.zip"
echo "TraitorDash: downloading DepotDownloader ${VERSION} (${ARCH})"
if ! curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$TMP/dd.zip" "$URL"; then
    echo "TraitorDash: the download failed; exact map geometry will not work until the server is reinstalled."
    exit 0
fi
if ! echo "${SUM}  $TMP/dd.zip" | sha256sum -c --quiet -; then
    echo "TraitorDash: the downloaded file does not match the pinned checksum and was discarded."
    exit 0
fi
mkdir -p "$DIR/bin"
unzip -o -q "$TMP/dd.zip" DepotDownloader LICENSE -d "$DIR/bin"
mv "$DIR/bin/LICENSE" "$DIR/bin/DepotDownloader.LICENSE"
chmod 755 "$DIR/bin/DepotDownloader"
echo "TraitorDash: DepotDownloader ${VERSION} installed in bin/."

variables.name: Public URL
variables.description: The address the dashboard is reached at, e.g. https://traitordash.example.com (no path; a trailing slash is ignored). Steam sends admins back to it after login, so it must be the address in their browser.

variables.name: Admin SteamID64s
variables.description: Comma-separated SteamID64s allowed to administer. Empty means nobody can log in.

variables.name: Session Secret
variables.description: Random string of at least 32 characters used to sign login sessions (openssl rand -hex 32). The app refuses to start without it. Change it to log everyone out.

variables.name: Node Environment
variables.description: production enables Secure cookies. Use development only on a trusted local network.

variables.name: Exact map geometry
variables.description: 1 downloads the Steam download helper (DepotDownloader, GPL-2.0, pinned and checked) at install time and lets admins switch on exact map geometry per map. Changing this needs a reinstall to fetch the helper. Off by default.
